completion_decisions: Six published turbine rows are exact anchors; the remaining 55 are deterministically completed under the paper's sorting and range constraints.
Missing commercial power curves use a declared monotone fifth-degree smoothstep completion.
Missing generic CT coefficients use a declared bounded fifth-degree CT(CPe) completion.
Missing MATLAB ga details use population 256, 5 percent elites, 0.8 scattered crossover, bounded mixed-variable mutation, and a 50-generation stall window.
All missing facts and resolutions are repeated in source-top declarations and the controlling contract.
